title: Contact Us - Hero
text: Contact Us. We'd love to hear from you. Call, message, or visit our campus in Kumasi.

title: Contact - Address
text: Address: Ayeduase New Site, K-5 Junction, Ayeduase Road, Kumasi, Ashanti Region, Ghana

title: Contact - Office Hours
text: Office Hours: Monday – Friday 7:00 AM – 4:00 PM

title: Complaints Policy
text: Parents and guardians are to channel all their grievances directly to the school administrator or the proprietress. Please do not lodge a complaint with a teacher or any other member of staff.

title: Contact - WhatsApp
text: Message us on WhatsApp. WhatsApp is the quickest way to reach us during office hours.

title: Admissions Enquiry
text: If you would rather apply straight away, the online form takes about five minutes. Admissions are not open at the moment, so there is no form to fill in yet — an enquiry now is how you hear about the next intake.

title: Google Maps Directions
text: Get directions on Google Maps. Map showing Novastar Montessori School in Kumasi.
